sources.name: misa
sources.note: 16/16 articles, re-extracted directly from the real bilingual PDF (uploaded by user) via pdf-parse, not the chat-pasted text. Each article now stores BOTH text_ar (Arabic, binding, chunked/embedded) and text_en (English, reference only, not embedded — embedding_en column unused in this pipeline version). Token-level language split, same method as before: drop pure-Latin tokens for text_ar, drop pure-Arabic-script tokens for text_en. Known remaining noise: PDF font-glyph substitution artifacts (e.g. stray Ņ/ł/Ĝ/Î glyphs) untouched, same caveat as other sources; a few words of the next article title sometimes leak onto the end of the previous article text due to interleaved page-header rendering in the source PDF (boundary-only, does not affect article completeness).
